title: LLM Unlearning on Noisy Forget Sets: A Study of Incomplete, Rewritten, and Watermarked Data
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical robustness of LLM unlearning algorithms when training data is noisy (incomplete, rewritten, or watermarked). Its experiments involve unlearning hazardous biosecurity knowledge and memorized book content, but it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, specific moral frameworks, or ethical philosophies.
